title: Composable Evidence Architecture — record schema v0.1
description: One record = one Learning Claim with the existing activities that touch it, the evidence gap, and the verification items that close part of that gap. Records nest upward through concept → standard → course → subject so they can be aggregated into a unit, course or department map. No renderer is implied; the same record should be able to render as a student page, a teacher key, a question-bank entry, an LMS item, or a curriculum map row. Fields removed from the kickoff candidate list and why: estimated_class_minutes (derivable from student_minutes + handling), novelty_requirement (subsumed by variant_rule), observable (definitional), limited_external_assistance (folded into supervision_condition + tools_allowed). Fields added: variant_rule, claim_type, cost_status, feed_forward_risk, no_short_check_reason, review.

concept.description: Course-level topic the claim belongs to, e.g. Linear functions

statement.description: Observable, with condition: 'computes the slope of a line from two points (integer coordinates, no context)'

misconception_targets.description: Named wrong models the claim is in tension with, e.g. 'slope = run/rise'

existing_activities.description: Activities the teacher already assigns that touch this claim. May be empty for a proposed claim.

delegability.description: Professional judgment: could a capable AI produce the observable artifact without the target understanding? Never numeric.

delegability_reason.description: Required. Names the task feature that drives the judgment.

feed_forward_risk.description: True if the artifact, once produced, could be supplied to an AI as context for later work (Track-2 falsification). Defaults true for any artifact that leaves the room.

what_it_supports.description: What a teacher can reasonably infer from this activity under its own conditions

evidence_gap.description: 'We cannot tell from [activity] whether the student …'. One sentence.

no_short_check_reason.description: Present only when no short independent item reaches the claim. Names where the evidence must come from instead (e.g. supervised extended task).

transfer_distance.description: Only for transfer items. Barnett & Ceci (2002) dimensions that changed relative to practice.

stem.description: Student-facing text of the base form. Markdown; no images required.

stimulus.description: Optional table/graph/flawed solution shown with the stem, as text.

options.description: Selected-response options if any. Must include 'Not sure'. Keyed position must vary across a set.

key.description: Correct answer(s). For generate items, the constraint checklist.

distractor_rationale.description: For each non-keyed option, the error it corresponds to.

scoring_rule.description: What counts as evidence / does not yet / flag. Two-level by default.

variant_rule.description: The item model: what may change for a fresh form, what must stay fixed to preserve the claim, how the key changes. Operationalises the novelty condition.

evidence_supported.description: 'Evidence this item can support:' — one sentence, scoped to the claim and conditions.

evidence_not_supported.description: 'Evidence this item cannot support:' — must name adjacent claims not reached and any guess-rate caveat.

supervision.description: Only proctored_in_class and observed_live satisfy the 'independent' condition.
